name: @botdesk/api
description: BotDesk API (Python, FastAPI). These scripts let pnpm and Turborepo run it like the other apps.

scripts.dev: uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn src.main:app --reload --port 8000 --loop asyncio:SelectorEventLoop
scripts.start: uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --loop asyncio:SelectorEventLoop
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
